literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在单靶标条件下,检测结果一致地检测到分支 I 和分支 II MPXV,浓度分别低至 6.8 × 10 -1 和 7.7 × 10 -1 拷贝/μL。 [10.1016/j.microc.2026.118902]
该程序从 597 名 猴痘 患者采集了 61,926 张标准化临床质量照片。 [10.1136/bmjgh-2025-020904]

NTV-ΔF1L-C7L 在 疫苗 生产细胞系中表现出显着增强的复制,与亲本 NTV 相比,MRC-5 细胞中的病毒产量增加了 680 倍以上;其对小鼠的致病力显着降低,与痘苗病毒天坛株(VTT)的致病力相比下降10倍以上;两次肌肉注射后,NTV-ΔF1L-C7L 引发高滴度的 正痘病毒 特异性 IgG 和针对牛痘和猴痘病毒的中和抗体,以及表现出 Th1 偏好的强大细胞 免疫应答,其明显强于亲本 NTV 或 VTT 疫苗接种 诱导的效果。 [10.1128/jvi.00943-26]
最后一次疗程后六个月,患者保持了良好的美学效果,朱红边界变形显着减少,患者报告的结果令人满意,没有感染、长时间红斑或色素沉着等并发症。 [10.5826/dpc.1603a7149]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Under single-target conditions, the assays consistently detected clade I and clade II MPXV at concentrations as low as 6.8 × 10 −1 and 7.7 × 10 −1 copies/μL, respectively. [10.1016/j.microc.2026.118902]
The procedures enabled the acquisition of 61,926 standardised, clinical-quality photographs from 597 patients with mpox. [10.1136/bmjgh-2025-020904]

NTV-ΔF1L-C7L exhibited significantly enhanced replication in vaccine production cell lines, with viral yields increasing by more than 680-fold in MRC-5 cells compared to those of the parental NTV; its pathogenicity in mice was significantly reduced, showing more than a 10-fold decrease compared to the pathogenicity of the vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT); following two intramuscular doses, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L elicited high titers of orthopoxvirus-specific IgG and neutralizing antibodies against vaccinia and monkeypox viruses, along with a robust cellular immune response exhibiting a Th1 bias, which was significantly stronger than that induced by either parental NTV or VTT vaccination. [10.1128/jvi.00943-26]
Of the 419 participants, 46.8% (95% CI: 42.0–51.7) had good knowledge, while 43.4% (95% CI: 39.1–48.0) showed positive attitudes toward mpox. [10.1002/hsr2.72854]

Six months after the final session, the patient maintained a good aesthetic result with significantly reduced vermilion border deformation and satisfactory patient-reported outcomes, with no complications such as infection, prolonged erythema, or dyspigmentation. [10.5826/dpc.1603a7149]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期猴痘病毒(Mpox病毒)研究集中呈现以下进展。
在单靶标条件下,检测结果一致地检测到分支 I 和分支 II MPXV,浓度分别低至 6.8 × 10 -1 和 7.7 × 10 -1 拷贝/μL。 [10.1016/j.microc.2026.118902]。
该程序从 597 名 猴痘 患者采集了 61,926 张标准化临床质量照片。 [10.1136/bmjgh-2025-020904]。

NTV-ΔF1L-C7L 在 疫苗 生产细胞系中表现出显着增强的复制,与亲本 NTV 相比,MRC-5 细胞中的病毒产量增加了 680 倍以上;其对小鼠的致病力显着降低,与痘苗病毒天坛株(VTT)的致病力相比下降10倍以上;两次肌肉注射后,NTV-ΔF1L-C7L 引发高滴度的 正痘病毒 特异性 IgG 和针对牛痘和猴痘病毒的中和抗体,以及表现出 Th1 偏好的强大细胞 免疫应答,其明显强于亲本 NTV 或 VTT 疫苗接种 诱导的效果。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.

Under single-target conditions, the assays consistently detected clade I and clade II MPXV at concentrations as low as 6.8 × 10 −1 and 7.7 × 10 −1 copies/μL, respectively. [10.1016/j.microc.2026.118902].
The procedures enabled the acquisition of 61,926 standardised, clinical-quality photographs from 597 patients with mpox. [10.1136/bmjgh-2025-020904].

NTV-ΔF1L-C7L exhibited significantly enhanced replication in vaccine production cell lines, with viral yields increasing by more than 680-fold in MRC-5 cells compared to those of the parental NTV; its pathogenicity in mice was significantly reduced, showing more than a 10-fold decrease compared to the pathogenicity of the vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT); following two intramuscular doses, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L elicited high titers of orthopoxvirus-specific IgG and neutralizing antibodies against vaccinia and monkeypox viruses, along with a robust cellular immune response exhibiting a Th1 bias, which was significantly stronger than that induced by either parental NTV or VTT vaccination.
Of the 419 participants, 46.8% (95% CI: 42.0–51.7) had good knowledge, while 43.4% (95% CI: 39.1–48.0) showed positive attitudes toward mpox. [10.1002/hsr2.72854].

[10.1016/j.microc.2026.118902]. The procedures enabled the acquisition of 61,926 standardised, clinical-quality photographs from 597 patients with mpox. [10.1136/bmjgh-2025-020904]. NTV-ΔF1L-C7L exhibited significantly enhanced replication in vaccine production cell lines, with viral yields increasing by more than 680-fold in MRC-5 cells compared to those of the parental NTV; its pathogenicity in mice was significantly reduced, showing more than a 10-fold decrease compared to the pathogenicity of the vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT); following two intramuscular doses, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L elicited high titers of orthopoxvirus-specific IgG and neutralizing antibodies against vaccinia and monkeypox viruses, along with a robust cellular immune response exhibiting a Th1 bias, which was significantly stronger than that induced by either parental NTV or VTT vaccination. Of the 419 participants, 46.8% (95% CI: 42.0–51.7) had good knowledge, while 43.4% (95% CI: 39.1–48.0) showed positive attitudes toward mpox. [10.1002/hsr2.72854].

papers.title: Total body photography for standardised documentation of mpox skin lesions in remote study sites in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
papers.abstract: We designed and successfully implemented photography protocols for the PALM007 (Pamoja Tulinde Maisha - Together Save Lives in Swahili) randomised clinical trial evaluating tecovirimat for the treatment of mpox in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). We addressed the unique challenges and limitations of conducting standardised photography procedures on patients with mpox in high-risk 'red zones' in remote study treatment centre sites. Key considerations included standardised photography protocols, training, quality assurance, participant privacy and comfort, and interpersonal communication. Our developed procedures enabled acquisition of 61 926 standardised, clinical-quality photographs of 597 patients with mpox. These considerations may guide future studies collecting standardised photographs in a low-resource setting.

papers.title: Mpox in Sierra Leone and the Mano River Union: an epidemic unfolding in real time.
papers.abstract: The 2025 mpox outbreak in Sierra Leone represents an unprecedented public health crisis, escalating rapidly from minimal prior cases to over 4400 confirmed infections within 6 months. This surge challenges previous assumptions about mpox epidemiology in West Africa and highlights critical vulnerabilities in disease surveillance, diagnostics and health system preparedness-challenges shared across the Mano River Union (MRU) region, including Liberia, Guinea and Côte d'Ivoire. Despite global commitments to equitable vaccine access, Sierra Leone and its neighbours have faced significant delays and fragmented mpox vaccine deployment, reflecting systemic failures in global health financing, vaccine ecosystems and governance. In this analysis, we examine the demographic and geographic features of the outbreak within Sierra Leone and the MRU, operational challenges and the urgent need for a coordinated equity-driven regional response. In doing so, we call for targeted vaccination, decentralised testing, the integration of mpox control into sexual health programmes and the strengthening of African vaccine manufacturing capacity. The outbreak underscores the necessity of rethinking global health governance to ensure timely sustained support for endemic and interconnected regions.

Despite global commitments to equitable vaccine access, Sierra Leone and its neighbours have faced significant delays and fragmented mpox vaccine deployment, reflecting systemic failures in global health financing, vaccine ecosystems and governance. In this analysis, we examine the demographic and geographic features of the outbreak within Sierra Leone and the MRU, operational challenges and the urgent need for a coordinated equity-driven regional response. In doing so, we call for targeted vaccination, decentralised testing, the integration of mpox control into sexual health programmes and the strengthening of African vaccine manufacturing capacity. The outbreak underscores the necessity of rethinking global health governance to ensure timely sustained support for endemic and interconnected regions.

papers.title: Bias in Estimating Subcritical Reproduction Numbers Under Imperfect Observation and Overlapping Transmission Chains: Theoretical Framework and Application to Mpox
papers.abstract: Abstract Estimating transmission potential and risk factors for emerging infections often relies on incomplete surveillance data. When infections are missed or their sources are misclassified, estimates of the effective reproduction number (Rs) and associations between case attributes and infection source may be biased. We developed an analytic framework to quantify and correct these biases, treating imperfect observation and entanglement of transmission chains as forms of misclassification that distort estimates of transmission parameters. The bias depends on the probability of case observation (Pobs) and the extent of concurrent introductions (Rp). We illustrate this framework using surveillance data for mpox in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1981–1986, 2013–2017), showing that incomplete observation leads to underestimation of Rs, whereas overlapping introductions can cause overestimation. Both types of bias also attenuate odds ratios for traits that distinguish primary (spillover) from secondary (human-tohuman) infections. Accounting for these biases provides context for the global emergence of mpox in 2022 and for how current transmission patterns differ from historical trends. These results demonstrate how standard epidemiologic concepts of misclassification and missingness can clarify bias in transmission studies and improve interpretation of surveillance data for emerging pathogens, including zoonoses and vaccine-preventable infections.

papers.title_zh: 不完美观察和重叠 传播 链下估计亚临界繁殖数的偏差:理论框架及其在 猴痘 中的应用
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Estimating transmission potential and risk factors for emerging infections often relies on incomplete surveillance data. When infections are missed or their sources are misclassified, estimates of the effective reproduction number (Rs) and associations between case attributes and infection source may be biased. We developed an analytic framework to quantify and correct these biases, treating imperfect observation and entanglement of transmission chains as forms of misclassification that distort estimates of transmission parameters. The bias depends on the probability of case observation (Pobs) and the extent of concurrent introductions (Rp). We illustrate this framework using surveillance data for mpox in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1981–1986, 2013–2017), showing that incomplete observation leads to underestimation of Rs, whereas overlapping introductions can cause overestimation. Both types of bias also attenuate odds ratios for traits that distinguish primary (spillover) from secondary (human-tohuman) infections. Accounting for these biases provides context for the global emergence of mpox in 2022 and for how current transmission patterns differ from historical trends. These results demonstrate how standard epidemiologic concepts of misclassification and missingness can clarify bias in transmission studies and improve interpretation of surveillance data for emerging pathogens, including zoonoses and vaccine-preventable infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 估计新发感染的 传播 潜在和危险因素通常依赖于不完整的 监测 数据。当感染被遗漏或其来源被错误分类时,对有效繁殖数(Rs)以及病例属性与感染源之间关联的估计可能会有偏差。我们开发了一个分析框架来量化和纠正这些偏差,将 传播 链的不完美观察和纠缠视为错误分类的形式,从而扭曲 传播 参数的估计。偏差取决于病例观察的概率 (Pobs) 和同时引入的程度 (Rp)。我们使用刚果民主共和国 猴痘 的 猴痘 数据(1981-1986、2013-2017)来说明该框架,表明不完整的观察会导致卢比的低估,而重叠的引入可能会导致高估。这两种类型的偏差也会减弱区分原发性(跨物种溢出)和继发性(人与人)感染的特征的比值比。考虑到这些偏差,为 2022 年 猴痘 在全球出现以及当前 传播 模式与历史趋势有何不同提供了背景。这些结果表明,错误分类和缺失的标准流行病学概念如何能够澄清 传播 研究中的偏差,并改善对新出现病原体(包括人畜共患病和 疫苗 可预防感染)的 监测 数据的解释。

papers.title: Immune dysfunction drives adverse mpox outcomes among people living with human immunodeficiency virus: a systematic review and meta-analysis with CD4-based risk stratification
papers.abstract: Background People living with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) accounted for a large share of cases during the 2022 multinational mpox outbreak, but whether adverse outcomes are attributable to HIV infection itself or to the degree of immune dysfunction remains uncertain. Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane methods. PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were searched from inception through January 31, 2026, with targeted literature updating through May 27, 2026. Observational studies reporting mpox outcomes stratified by HIV status were eligible. The primary outcome was hospitalization. Risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using DerSimonian-Laird random-effects models. Results Twenty studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 13 studies comprising 32,685 participants were included in the hospitalization meta-analysis. HIV infection was associated with increased hospitalization risk (RR, 1.40; 95% CI, 1.07–1.85; I 2 = 81%). The 95% prediction interval was wide (0.54–3.65), indicating that context, case mix, and hospitalization thresholds influenced observed effects. CD4-stratified evidence was not sufficiently uniform for a valid pooled CD4-specific effect estimate, but available studies consistently indicated that low CD4 count, uncontrolled HIV viremia, and disengagement from HIV care identify the subgroup at greatest risk for hospitalization, severe disease, prolonged infection, and death. Conclusion Adverse mpox outcomes among people living with HIV are better explained by immune status and HIV disease control than by HIV serostatus alone. CD4-based risk stratification provides a clinically actionable framework for triage, follow-up intensity, antiviral-treatment consideration, and integration of mpox management with HIV care.

papers.source_body_en: Background People living with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) accounted for a large share of cases during the 2022 multinational mpox outbreak, but whether adverse outcomes are attributable to HIV infection itself or to the degree of immune dysfunction remains uncertain. Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane methods. PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were searched from inception through January 31, 2026, with targeted literature updating through May 27, 2026. Observational studies reporting mpox outcomes stratified by HIV status were eligible. The primary outcome was hospitalization. Risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using DerSimonian-Laird random-effects models. Results Twenty studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 13 studies comprising 32,685 participants were included in the hospitalization meta-analysis. HIV infection was associated with increased hospitalization risk (RR, 1.40; 95% CI, 1.07–1.85; I 2 = 81%). The 95% prediction interval was wide (0.54–3.65), indicating that context, case mix, and hospitalization thresholds influenced observed effects. CD4-stratified evidence was not sufficiently uniform for a valid pooled CD4-specific effect estimate, but available studies consistently indicated that low CD4 count, uncontrolled HIV viremia, and disengagement from HIV care identify the subgroup at greatest risk for hospitalization, severe disease, prolonged infection, and death. Conclusion Adverse mpox outcomes among people living with HIV are better explained by immune status and HIV disease control than by HIV serostatus alone. CD4-based risk stratification provides a clinically actionable framework for triage, follow-up intensity, antiviral-treatment consideration, and integration of mpox management with HIV care.

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics of Mpox and Mpox– HIV Coinfection in Lima, Peru: A Retrospective Multicenter Analysis
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to assess the clinical characteristics and outcomes of mpox and mpox-HIV coinfection in Lima, Peru, during the 2022-2023 outbreak. Also, it sought to identify predictors of hospitalisation, particularly related to HIV immunosuppression. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective analysis of 588 individuals with confirmed mpox across three public referral hospitals in Lima, Peru, between June 2022 and January 2023. Data were extracted from mpox surveillance forms, medical charts, and laboratory systems. Descriptive statistics and bivariate analyses were performed, followed by multivariate logistic regression to identify predictors of hospitalisation. RESULTS: Among the 588 individuals with mpox, the mean age was 32.1 years, and 54.8% were people living with HIV (PLWH). Hospitalisation occurred in 8% of individuals, with a higher rate among PLWH (11.2%) compared to individuals without HIV (4.1%). Proctitis and a CD4 count < 500 cells/μL were significant predictors of hospitalisation (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 7.47 and 5.74, respectively). Lesion counts were lower in PLWH, and a distinct rash distribution was observed. Six deaths occurred, all in PLWH, with sepsis being the leading cause. CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the clinical differences of mpox between PLWH and people without HIV in Lima, with even mild HIV-related immunosuppression (CD4 < 500 cells/μL) and proctitis being key factors for hospitalisation. Deaths occurred exclusively in PLWH, emphasising the importance of managing HIV effectively to mitigate severe mpox outcomes. Strengthening HIV care and ensuring access to mpox treatment are critical in response strategies for future outbreaks.

papers.title: Clinical course and virologic dynamics of Mpox during tecovirimat treatment: Prospective multicenter case series in Japan
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: At the time of this study, no approved treatment for mpox was available in Japan, and data on the clinical course and virological changes during tecovirimat treatment were limited. METHODS: We conducted a prospective multicenter observational case series of patients with PCR-confirmed mpox between June 28, 2022, and March 31, 2025, to describe the clinical course and safety of a 14-day course of tecovirimat. Participants could choose treatment or no treatment. RESULTS: All 31 participants received tecovirimat; 24 completed a single 14-day course, and 2 received multiple courses plus vaccinia immune globulin. The median age was 39 years (range, 21-74), and all were men. Nineteen (61.3%) were people living with HIV, with a median CD4 count of 531 cells/μL (range, 50-830), including three with CD4 counts <200 cells/μL. Severe mpox occurred in 23 participants (74.2%), three of whom (9.7%) had risk factors for severe disease, all due to CD4 < 200 cells/μL. Skin lesions were present in 30 participants. At day 14, skin PCR results were available for 23 participants; 16 (69.6%) were negative. No deaths occurred within 14 or 30 days, although one patient with advanced HIV infection died following prolonged hospitalization. Adverse events occurred in 2 participants and were considered unrelated to treatment. DISCUSSION: This prospective multicenter case series describes the clinical course of mpox and temporal dynamics of skin PCR negativity in patients receiving tecovirimat in real-world practice.

papers.title: Knowledge and Attitudes of Healthcare Workers Toward the Re‐Emergence of Human Monkeypox Virus Infection in Public Health Facilities in the Central Ethiopia Region: An Online Cross‐Sectional Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Human monkeypox (mpox) is a re‐emerging zoonotic viral disease in Africa. Despite recent reports in Ethiopia, no studies have assessed healthcare workers' (HCWs) knowledge and attitudes in the Central Ethiopia Region. This study aimed to determine HCWs knowledge and attitudes toward the re‐emergence of mpox in public health facilities. Methods From June 16 to 28, 2025, 419 HCWs were chosen at random for an online cross‐sectional study. The data were gathered using a self‐administered questionnaire distributed through Google Forms. We used SPSS version 26 for the statistical analysis. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with knowledge and attitudes. Adjusted odds ratios (AORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were used to determine statistical significance. Results Of the 419 participants, 46.8% (95% CI: 42.0–51.7) had good knowledge, while 43.4% (95% CI: 39.1–48.0) showed positive attitudes. Good knowledge were significantly positively associated with a master's degree or higher (AOR = 3.46; 95% CI: 1.60–7.47), health officer (AOR = 7.00; 95% CI: 3.20–15.32) and pharmacist (AOR = 2.68; 95% CI: 1.17–6.13), low (AOR = 5.15; 95% CI: 2.02–13.10) and medium monthly income (AOR = 2.35; 95% CI: 1.32–4.20), and positive attitude (AOR = 2.11; 95% CI: 1.25–3.59), in contrast significantly negatively associated with work experience (5–10 years) (AOR = 0.13; 95% CI: 0.07–0.24). Positive attitudes were significantly positively associated with medical doctor (AOR = 4.78; 95% CI: 2.39–9.55), and information about mpox during medical education (AOR = 3.29; 95% CI: 1.91–5.67), in contrast significantly negatively associated with female sex (AOR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.08–0.41), age ≥ 32 years (AOR = 0.45; 95% CI: 0.28–0.73), and lack of current information access (AOR = 0.47; 95% CI: 0.26–0.88). Conclusion HCWs had low levels of knowledge and positive attitudes toward mpox. To get better at being ready for and responding to mpox in Ethiopia, it is important to strengthen continuing professional education, target training, and raise awareness.

papers.title: Modelling Quarantine in Monkeypox Virus Transmission: A Critical Appraisal of Construct Definition, Parameter Evidence and Policy Inference
papers.abstract: Quarantine occupies an unusual position in the quantitative literature on mpox. It is among the most frequently simulated control measures in transmission models of monkeypox virus (MPXV), yet it is among the least precisely specified. The 2022 multi-country outbreak driven by clade IIb, and the subsequent expansion of clade I transmission in central and eastern Africa, prompted a rapid proliferation of compartmental, network and individual-based models in which a quarantine class or a quarantine rate is used to represent the removal of exposed or infectious individuals from effective contact. This review examines how the quarantine construct has been defined, parameterised, calibrated and interpreted across that literature, and asks whether the resulting policy claims are supported by the evidence on which they rest. Literature was identified through structured searches of accessible scholarly indexes and metadata services, supplemented by backward and forward citation searching and by consultation of authoritative institutional sources, and was appraised against criteria covering construct validity, structural assumptions, parameter provenance, calibration, uncertainty treatment and inferential logic. Six critical findings emerge. Quarantine of exposed contacts and isolation of symptomatic cases are routinely conflated, so that reported effect sizes refer to different interventions under a single label. Deterministic homogeneous-mixing architectures dominate, although MPXV transmission is strongly overdispersed and network-structured. Quarantine parameters are typically assumed rather than estimated, and sensitivity analyses are frequently conducted over invented rather than empirical ranges. The recurrent result that raising the quarantine rate reduces the reproduction number is largely a structural consequence of model formulation rather than an empirical discovery. Data-anchored analyses reach substantially more conditional conclusions than parameter-sweep analyses. Empirical evaluations of isolation and contact tracing report weak certainty of effect and substantial operational failure, particularly in endemic settings. Quarantine effectiveness is contingent on clade, transmission route, detection delay and adherence, and models that omit these contingencies overstate what quarantine can achieve. Priorities include construct standardisation, joint estimation of detection and isolation delays, and explicit representation of adherence and equity constraints.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines the quantitative literature on quarantine in monkeypox virus (MPXV) transmission models, focusing on construct definition, parameter evidence, and policy inference. The central question is whether policy claims about quarantine effectiveness are supported by the underlying evidence.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review used structured searches of scholarly indexes and metadata services, supplemented by backward and forward citation searching and consultation of authoritative institutional sources. Literature was appraised against criteria covering construct validity, structural assumptions, parameter provenance, calibration, uncertainty treatment, and inferential logic.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Six critical findings emerge: quarantine of exposed contacts and isolation of symptomatic cases are routinely conflated; deterministic homogeneous-mixing models dominate despite MPXV's overdispersed transmission; quarantine parameters are typically assumed rather than estimated; the effect of quarantine rates on reproduction numbers is largely a structural consequence; data-anchored analyses yield more conditional conclusions than parameter-sweep analyses; and empirical evaluations report weak certainty of effect and operational failure, particularly in endemic settings.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Key controversies include the conflation of quarantine and isolation constructs, the dominance of simplistic model structures that fail to capture MPXV's transmission dynamics, and the reliance on assumed rather than estimated parameters. Evidence gaps include the lack of empirical ranges for sensitivity analyses, insufficient representation of adherence and equity constraints, and inadequate consideration of clade-specific, transmission route-specific, and context-specific factors affecting quarantine effectiveness.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Priorities include standardizing quarantine constructs, jointly estimating detection and isolation delays, and explicitly representing adherence and equity constraints in models. The findings suggest that policy claims about quarantine effectiveness should be interpreted with caution, particularly when based on simplistic models or assumed parameters, and that more context-specific, empirically grounded approaches are needed.

analysis.summary_en: This review critically appraises quarantine in monkeypox virus transmission models, revealing six key findings: conflation of quarantine and isolation constructs, dominance of simplistic homogeneous-mixing models, reliance on assumed parameters, structural rather than empirical effects on reproduction numbers, more conditional conclusions from data-anchored analyses, and weak empirical evidence for effectiveness. The review highlights controversies around model simplification and parameter assumptions, and identifies gaps in empirical ranges, adherence representation, and context-specific factors. Implications include standardizing constructs, jointly estimating delays, and incorporating equity constraints, with caution advised for policy claims based on simplistic models.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述考察了有关猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 传播 模型检疫的定量文献,重点关注构造定义、参数证据和政策推断。核心问题是有关检疫有效性的政策主张是否得到基础证据的支持。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述采用了学术索引和元数据服务的结构化搜索,并辅以向后和向前的引文搜索以及权威机构资源的咨询。根据涵盖构造有效性、结构假设、参数来源、校准、不确定性 治疗 和推理逻辑的标准对文献进行评估。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 出现了六项重要发现:对暴露接触者的隔离和对有症状病例的隔离通常被混为一谈;尽管 MPXV 的 传播 过度分散,但确定性均匀混合模型仍占主导地位;检疫参数通常是假设的而不是估计的;检疫率对繁殖数量的影响很大程度上是结构性后果;数据锚定分析比参数扫描分析产生更多有条件的结论;实证评估报告效果确定性较弱且操作失败,特别是在流行情况下。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 主要争议包括检疫和隔离结构的合并、无法捕获 MPXV 的 传播 动态的简单化模型结构的主导地位,以及对假设参数而不是估计参数的依赖。证据差距包括缺乏敏感性分析的经验范围,对遵守和公平约束的代表性不足,以及对影响检疫有效性的特定进化枝、传播 路线特定和环境特定因素考虑不足。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先事项包括标准化隔离结构、联合估计检测和隔离延迟以及在模型中明确表示遵守和公平约束。研究结果表明,应谨慎解释有关检疫有效性的政策主张,特别是在基于简单化模型或假设参数时,并且需要更加针对具体情况、以经验为基础的方法。

Quarantine parameters are typically assumed rather than estimated, and sensitivity analyses are frequently conducted over invented rather than empirical ranges. The recurrent result that raising the quarantine rate reduces the reproduction number is largely a structural consequence of model formulation rather than an empirical discovery. Data-anchored analyses reach substantially more conditional conclusions than parameter-sweep analyses. Empirical evaluations of isolation and contact tracing report weak certainty of effect and substantial operational failure, particularly in endemic settings. Quarantine effectiveness is contingent on clade, transmission route, detection delay and adherence, and models that omit these contingencies overstate what quarantine can achieve. Priorities include construct standardisation, joint estimation of detection and isolation delays, and explicit representation of adherence and equity constraints.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述考察了有关猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 传播 模型检疫的定量文献,重点关注构造定义、参数证据和政策推断。核心问题是有关检疫有效性的政策主张是否得到基础证据的支持。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述采用了学术索引和元数据服务的结构化搜索,并辅以向后和向前的引文搜索以及权威机构资源的咨询。根据涵盖构造有效性、结构假设、参数来源、校准、不确定性 治疗 和推理逻辑的标准对文献进行评估。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 出现了六项重要发现:对暴露接触者的隔离和对有症状病例的隔离通常被混为一谈;尽管 MPXV 的 传播 过度分散,但确定性均匀混合模型仍占主导地位;检疫参数通常是假设的而不是估计的;检疫率对繁殖数量的影响很大程度上是结构性后果;数据锚定分析比参数扫描分析产生更多有条件的结论;实证评估报告效果确定性较弱且操作失败,特别是在流行情况下。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 主要争议包括检疫和隔离结构的合并、无法捕获 MPXV 的 传播 动态的简单化模型结构的主导地位,以及对假设参数而不是估计参数的依赖。证据差距包括缺乏敏感性分析的经验范围,对遵守和公平约束的代表性不足,以及对影响检疫有效性的特定进化枝、传播 路线特定和环境特定因素考虑不足。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先事项包括标准化隔离结构、联合估计检测和隔离延迟以及在模型中明确表示遵守和公平约束。研究结果表明,应谨慎解释有关检疫有效性的政策主张,特别是在基于简单化模型或假设参数时,并且需要更加针对具体情况、以经验为基础的方法。

papers.title: Enhanced replication and immunogenicity of a genome-modified non-replicating vaccinia virus Tiantan strain for robust low-dose protection in mice
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT A non-replicating Tiantan strain-based vaccinia virus (NTV) holds significant application prospects for vaccination and gene therapy and has recently entered clinical trials as a novel and safer vaccine candidate against monkeypox. However, optimization is still required, particularly regarding its production capacity and immunogenicity. In this study, a recombinant virus was constructed by modifying the F1L and C7L genes in a non-replicating viral backbone using CRISPR/Cas9-mediated gene editing and homologous recombination. The resulting construct, designated NTV-ΔF1L-C7L, exhibited significantly enhanced replication in vaccine production cell lines, with viral yields increasing by more than 680-fold in MRC-5 cells compared to those of the parental NTV. Its pathogenicity in mice was significantly reduced, showing more than a 10-fold decrease compared to the pathogenicity of the vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT). Following two intramuscular doses, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L elicited high titers of orthopoxvirus-specific IgG and neutralizing antibodies against vaccinia and monkeypox viruses, along with a robust cellular immune response exhibiting a Th1 bias, which was significantly stronger than that induced by either parental NTV or VTT vaccination. Complete protection (100%) against a lethal challenge with the vaccinia virus Western Reserve strain was achieved in mice immunized with either a low dose (10 3 PFU) or a single dose (105 PFU) of NTV-ΔF1L-C7L, comparable to that conferred by VTT. These findings demonstrate that NTV-ΔF1L-C7L combines high safety with enhanced replication and immunogenicity, supporting its value as a novel vaccine vector and its potential application in controlling the current global monkeypox outbreak. IMPORTANCE A highly attenuated NTV exhibits an improved safety profile; however, its production capacity and immunogenicity require optimization for clinical application. In this study, a novel recombinant virus, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L, was developed by targeting the deletion of F1L and the insertion of C7L into the NTV backbone. This attenuated live vaccine, NTV-ΔF1L-C7L, demonstrates several significant advantages. Its robust in vitro replication supports scalability for large-scale vaccine production. It has demonstrated strong immunoprotective efficacy in mice while maintaining a high safety margin, exhibiting reduced pathogenicity in vivo , and inducing robust humoral and cellular immune responses against vaccinia and monkeypox virus. These immune responses confer complete protection against lethal VACV challenge at low-dose or single-dose immunization. These findings establish a solid experimental foundation for the further development of NTV-ΔF1L-C7L as a next-generation VACV-based vector or a candidate vaccine against mpox.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: NTV-ΔF1L-C7L 表现出几个显着的优势,包括强大的体外复制支持大规模 疫苗 生产的可扩展性、在保持高安全裕度的同时对小鼠具有强大的免疫保护功效,以及在低剂量或单剂量免疫时完全防止致命的 VACV 攻击。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的具体局限性;然而,证据强度很高,因为该研究表明复制、致病性和免疫原性显着改善,并能完全保护小鼠免受致命攻击。

papers.title: Tecovirimat treatment of clade II mpox: a virological analysis of a randomised, double-blind, phase 3 trial.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a global public health threat. Three phase 3 trials of tecovirimat showed no substantial clinical benefit. We report virus isolation and sequencing results from the Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally (ACTG) A5418-The Study of Tecovirimat for Human Mpox (A5418-STOMP). METHODS: ACTG A5418-STOMP was a phase 3 randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial (NCT05534984) with an additional open-label arm enrolling paediatric, pregnant, severely immunosuppressed, or severe-disease participants. Day 1 (baseline), day 8, and day 15 index lesion skin swabs were used for virus isolation. Deep sequencing of the F13L gene was performed on index and new skin lesions, and on rectal, oral, vaginal, blood, and urine specimens through day 57. A predefined list of resistance-associated mutations (RAMs) was used to classify participants as having no RAMs, transmitted RAMs, or treatment-emergent RAMs. Proportions were compared using Fisher's exact tests; duration-normalised log10 MPXV DNA copies were compared using Mann-Whitney U tests. P values were adjusted using Benjamini-Hochberg corrections where applicable. FINDINGS: Among participants who were culture-positive on day 1 with available day 8 swabs, five (9%) of 53 in the randomised tecovirimat arm, three (12%) of 25 in the placebo arm, and eight (12%) of 67 in the open-label arm were culture-positive on day 8 (p=0·71). Among participants with day 1 and longitudinal sequencing data available, treatment-emergent resistance was observed in one (2%) of 54 of the randomised tecovirimat arm, zero of 29 of the placebo arm, and six (65%) of 92 of the open-label arm. Participants with treatment-emergent resistance had significantly higher longitudinal viral loads (p=0·0014) and lower clinical resolution rates by day 57 (28·6% vs 94·7%; p=3·8 × 10-5) than those without resistance mutations. Six of seven individuals with treatment-emergent variants were living with HIV; all five with available baseline CD4+ T-cell counts recorded values below 80 cells per μL. Among 23 immunocompromised participants living with HIV, five (22%) developed treatment-emergent RAMs, with markedly lower clinical resolution rates than those who did not (one [20%] of five vs 17 [94%] of 18; p=0·0027). INTERPRETATION: Although treatment-emergent resistance to tecovirimat was rare overall, it was observed more often in participants living with advanced HIV and profoundly impaired cellular immunity, leading to persistently higher viral loads and delayed clinical recovery. Tecovirimat therapy of mpox infection did not reduce the frequency of MPXV isolation from skin swabs. Novel therapeutic options are needed to address mpox infection. FUNDING: Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally and the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, US National Institutes of Health.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated tecovirimat treatment efficacy against clade II mpox in a phase 3 randomised, placebo-controlled trial with an open-label extension. The analysis focused on virological outcomes, including virus isolation and deep sequencing of the F13L gene. Results showed no substantial clinical benefit of tecovirimat, with similar culture-positive rates between treatment and placebo arms. Treatment-emergent resistance was rare in the randomised arm but frequent in the open-label arm, particularly among immunocompromised participants living with advanced HIV. These individuals had higher viral loads and lower clinical resolution rates. The findings suggest tecovirimat does not reduce MPXV isolation and highlight the need for alternative treatments for immunocompromised patients.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a global public health threat, necessitating evaluation of tecovirimat treatment efficacy against clade II mpox.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: ACTG A5418-STOMP was a phase 3 randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial (NCT05534984) with an additional open-label arm enrolling paediatric, pregnant, severely immunosuppressed, or severe-disease participants.
analysis_en.methods: Day 1 (baseline), day 8, and day 15 index lesion skin swabs were used for virus isolation; deep sequencing of the F13L gene was performed on index and new skin lesions, and on rectal, oral, vaginal, blood, and urine specimens through day 57; proportions were compared using Fisher's exact tests and duration-normalised log10 MPXV DNA copies using Mann-Whitney U tests.
analysis_en.main_results: Among participants who were culture-positive on day 1 with available day 8 swabs, five (9%) of 53 in the randomised tecovirimat arm, three (12%) of 25 in the placebo arm, and eight (12%) of 67 in the open-label arm were culture-positive on day 8 (p=0·71); treatment-emergent resistance was observed in one (2%) of 54 of the randomised tecovirimat arm, zero of 29 of the placebo arm, and six (65%) of 92 of the open-label arm; participants with treatment-emergent resistance had significantly higher longitudinal viral loads (p=0·0014) and lower clinical resolution rates by day 57 (28·6% vs 94·7%; p=3·8 × 10-5) than those without resistance mutations.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Although treatment-emergent resistance to tecovirimat was rare overall, it was observed more often in participants living with advanced HIV and profoundly impaired cellular immunity, leading to persistently higher viral loads and delayed clinical recovery; tecovirimat therapy of mpox infection did not reduce the frequency of MPXV isolation from skin swabs.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Novel therapeutic options are needed to address mpox infection, particularly for immunocompromised individuals living with HIV who may develop treatment-emergent resistance and experience poorer clinical outcomes.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the study's randomised design and comprehensive virological analysis, but limitations include the small sample size for certain subgroups and the potential for confounding factors in the open-label arm.

papers.title_zh: 进化枝 II 猴痘 的 特考韦瑞 治疗:随机、双盲、3 期试验的病毒学分析。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a global public health threat. Three phase 3 trials of tecovirimat showed no substantial clinical benefit. We report virus isolation and sequencing results from the Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally (ACTG) A5418-The Study of Tecovirimat for Human Mpox (A5418-STOMP). METHODS: ACTG A5418-STOMP was a phase 3 randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial (NCT05534984) with an additional open-label arm enrolling paediatric, pregnant, severely immunosuppressed, or severe-disease participants. Day 1 (baseline), day 8, and day 15 index lesion skin swabs were used for virus isolation. Deep sequencing of the F13L gene was performed on index and new skin lesions, and on rectal, oral, vaginal, blood, and urine specimens through day 57. A predefined list of resistance-associated mutations (RAMs) was used to classify participants as having no RAMs, transmitted RAMs, or treatment-emergent RAMs. Proportions were compared using Fisher's exact tests; duration-normalised log10 MPXV DNA copies were compared using Mann-Whitney U tests. P values were adjusted using Benjamini-Hochberg corrections where applicable. FINDINGS: Among participants who were culture-positive on day 1 with available day 8 swabs, five (9%) of 53 in the randomised tecovirimat arm, three (12%) of 25 in the placebo arm, and eight (12%) of 67 in the open-label arm were culture-positive on day 8 (p=0·71). Among participants with day 1 and longitudinal sequencing data available, treatment-emergent resistance was observed in one (2%) of 54 of the randomised tecovirimat arm, zero of 29 of the placebo arm, and six (65%) of 92 of the open-label arm. Participants with treatment-emergent resistance had significantly higher longitudinal viral loads (p=0·0014) and lower clinical resolution rates by day 57 (28·6% vs 94·7%; p=3·8 × 10-5) than those without resistance mutations. Six of seven individuals with treatment-emergent variants were living with HIV; all five with available baseline CD4+ T-cell counts recorded values below 80 cells per μL. Among 23 immunocompromised participants living with HIV, five (22%) developed treatment-emergent RAMs, with markedly lower clinical resolution rates than those who did not (one [20%] of five vs 17 [94%] of 18; p=0·0027). INTERPRETATION: Although treatment-emergent resistance to tecovirimat was rare overall, it was observed more often in participants living with advanced HIV and profoundly impaired cellular immunity, leading to persistently higher viral loads and delayed clinical recovery. Tecovirimat therapy of mpox infection did not reduce the frequency of MPXV isolation from skin swabs. Novel therapeutic options are needed to address mpox infection. FUNDING: Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally and the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, US National Institutes of Health.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘病毒(MPXV)已成为全球公共卫生威胁。特考韦瑞 的三项 3 期试验未显示出实质性的临床益处。我们报告了全球推进临床治疗 (ACTG) A5418-特考韦瑞 人类 猴痘 的研究 (A5418-STOMP) 的病毒分离和测序结果。方法:ACTG A5418-STOMP 是一项 3 期随机、安慰剂对照、双盲试验 (NCT05534984),另外还有一个开放标签组,招募儿童、孕妇、严重免疫抑制或严重疾病参与者。第 1 天(基线)、第 8 天和第 15 天指数病变皮肤拭子用于病毒分离。对第 57 天的指数和新皮损以及直肠、口腔、阴道、血液和尿液样本进行 F13L 基因的深度测序。使用预定义的耐药相关 突变 (RAM) 列表将参与者分类为无 RAM、传播 RAM 或 治疗 出现 RAM。使用费舍尔精确检验比较比例;使用 Mann-Whitney U 检验比较持续时间归一化的 log10 MPXV DNA 拷贝。P 值在适用的情况下使用 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正进行调整。结果:在第 1 天使用第 8 天可用拭子检测呈培养阳性的参与者中,随机 特考韦瑞 组中 53 名参与者中的 5 名 (9%)、安慰剂组中 25 名参与者中的 3 名 (12%) 和开放标签组中 67 名参与者中的 8 名 (12%) 在第 8 天时培养呈阳性 (p=0·71)。在拥有第一天和纵向测序数据的参与者中,随机 特考韦瑞 组的 54 名参与者中有 1 名 (2%) 观察到了 治疗 突发耐药性,安慰剂组的 29 名参与者中有 0 名观察到了 治疗 突发耐药性,而开放标签组的 92 名参与者中有 6 名 (65%) 观察到了 治疗 突发耐药性。与没有耐药性的 治疗 参与者相比,具有 治疗 耐药性的参与者在第 57 天时具有显着更高的纵向病毒载量 (p=0·0014) 和较低的临床解决率 (28·6% vs 94·7%;p=3·8 × 10-5)。携带 治疗 突变体的 7 名个体中,有 6 名感染了 HIV;所有五个可用基线 CD4+ T 细胞计数的记录值均低于每 μL 80 个细胞。在 23 名免疫功能低下的 HIV 感染者中,有 5 名 (22%) 出现了 治疗 紧急 RAM,其临床解决率明显低于未出现 RAM 的患者(5 名感染者中的 1 名 [20%] vs 18 名中的 17 名 [94%];p=0·0027)。解释:虽然总体而言,治疗 出现的对 特考韦瑞 的耐药性很少见,但在晚期 HIV 患者和细胞免疫严重受损的参与者中更常见,导致病毒载量持续较高和临床恢复延迟。特考韦瑞 治疗 猴痘 感染并没有降低从皮肤拭子中分离 MPXV 的频率。需要新的治疗方案来解决 猴痘 感染。资助:在全球范围内推进临床治疗以及美国国立卫生研究院国家过敏和传染病研究所。

papers.title: Next-Generation Mpox Vaccine: Enhancing MVA-Based Immunity Through PD-1 Checkpoint Modulation 2309232
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction The 2022 Mpox outbreak exposed gaps in orthopoxvirus vaccine durability, as the licensed two-dose Modified Vaccinia Ankara (MVA) regimen provides only moderate and waning protection. Durable antiviral immunity requires coordinated humoral and CD8+ T-cell responses, with CD8+ T cells playing an important role in controlling infected cells at sites of viral replication. However, current vaccine strategies incompletely sustain these cellular responses. To address this limitation, MVA-X was engineered as an MVA-based vaccine in which a PD-1 antagonist peptide is encoded directly within the viral genome, enabling localized checkpoint modulation during antigen presentation. Methods Age- and sex-matched C57BL/6 mice received formulation buffer, single-dose MVA, two-dose MVA, or single-dose MVA-X. Mice were challenged with lethal vaccinia virus (VACV-WR) at days 55, 90, or 150 post-prime. Vaccine efficacy and immune responses were evaluated by survival, lung viral titers and genome burden, lung histopathology and immunohistochemistry, serum neutralization and binding antibody assays, and virus-specific CD8+ T-cell responses. Results A single dose of MVA-X conferred complete survival at all challenge time points, matching or exceeding two doses of MVA protection. At day 90 post-challenge, MVA-X vaccination resulted in > 97% reductions in lung viral titers and genome copies, preservation of alveolar architecture, and localized peribronchiolar immune infiltrates, consistent with efficient tissue-level viral control. Despite declining binding antibody responses, animals remained protected, consistent with sustained virus-specific CD8+ T-cell responses detectable through day 150 post-prime. Conclusion These findings show that MVA-X supports durable cellular immune responses following a single immunization. This vaccine-intrinsic checkpoint modulation strategy offers a modular framework with broader applicability for enhancing cellular immunity in viral vaccine development. Funding Source GeoVax,Inc Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.research_question_and_background: The 2022 Mpox outbreak exposed gaps in orthopoxvirus vaccine durability, as the licensed two-dose Modified Vaccinia Ankara (MVA) regimen provides only moderate and waning protection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Age- and sex-matched C57BL/6 mice received formulation buffer, single-dose MVA, two-dose MVA, or single-dose MVA-X and were challenged with lethal vaccinia virus (VACV-WR) at days 55, 90, or 150 post-prime.
analysis.methods: Vaccine efficacy and immune responses were evaluated by survival, lung viral titers and genome burden, lung histopathology and immunohistochemistry, serum neutralization and binding antibody assays, and virus-specific CD8+ T-cell responses.
analysis.main_results: A single dose of MVA-X conferred complete survival at all challenge time points, matching or exceeding two doses of MVA protection, and resulted in >97% reductions in lung viral titers and genome copies at day 90 post-challenge.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings show that MVA-X supports durable cellular immune responses following a single immunization, offering a modular framework with broader applicability for enhancing cellular immunity in viral vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This vaccine-intrinsic checkpoint modulation strategy could improve mpox vaccine durability and reduce the number of doses required, potentially enhancing outbreak control and reducing logistical burdens in vaccination campaigns.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate as the study was conducted in a mouse model with vaccinia virus challenge, which may not fully translate to human mpox infection or natural disease progression.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the limited durability of current mpox vaccines by developing MVA-X, an MVA-based vaccine encoding a PD-1 antagonist peptide to enhance cellular immunity. In a mouse model, a single dose of MVA-X provided complete survival against lethal vaccinia virus challenge at multiple time points, outperforming or matching the two-dose MVA regimen. MVA-X achieved >97% reductions in lung viral titers and genome copies, preserved tissue architecture, and maintained protective CD8+ T-cell responses for up to 150 days despite declining antibody levels. This demonstrates that vaccine-intrinsic checkpoint modulation can induce durable cellular immunity with fewer doses, offering a promising strategy for improving mpox vaccine efficacy and reducing logistical challenges in outbreak response.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2022 年 猴痘 暴发 暴露了 正痘病毒 疫苗 耐久性方面的差距,因为获得许可的两剂改良痘苗安卡拉 (MVA) 方案仅提供中等且逐渐减弱的保护。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 年龄和性别匹配的 C57BL/6 小鼠接受制剂缓冲液、单剂量 MVA、两剂量 MVA 或单剂量 MVA-X,并在免疫后第 55、90 或 150 天用致死痘苗病毒 (VACV-WR) 进行攻击。
elements_zh.methods: 通过生存、肺病毒滴度和 基因组 负荷、肺组织病理学和免疫组织化学、血清中和和结合抗体测定以及病毒特异性 CD8+ T 细胞反应来评估 疫苗 功效和 免疫应答。
elements_zh.main_results: 单剂 MVA-X 在所有攻击时间点均能实现完全存活,相当于或超过两剂 MVA 保护,并导致攻击后第 90 天肺部病毒滴度和 基因组 拷贝数降低 >97%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些研究结果表明,MVA-X 在一次免疫后支持持久的细胞 免疫应答,提供了一个具有更广泛适用性的模块化框架,用于增强病毒 疫苗 开发中的细胞免疫。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这种 疫苗 内在检查点调制策略可以提高 猴痘 疫苗 的耐久性并减少所需的剂量数量,从而可能增强 暴发 的控制并减少 疫苗接种 活动中的后勤负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是在痘苗病毒攻击的小鼠模型中进行的,这可能无法完全转化为人类 猴痘 感染或自然疾病进展。

papers.title: In situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex.
papers.abstract: Abstract Poxviruses are a family of large, complex double-stranded DNA viruses that includes human pathogens such as variola—the cause of smallpox—and monkeypox. Recent outbreaks of mpox underscore the need for a better understanding of poxvirus biology 1,2 . Poxvirus assembly is a conserved process that involves the formation of a biconcave core inside the membrane of the maturing virus 3,4 . Here we use cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging and structure prediction to determine the structure and composition of the portal complex—a pore that spans the core wall—in vaccinia virus, the prototypical poxvirus. The hexameric complex consists of the E8, E6 and L3 proteins, which are conserved across poxviruses and essential for mRNA release during the establishment of infection 5–7 . E6, which is also required for virus assembly 8–10 , forms the central chamber of the portal and interacts with the surrounding core wall. A hexamer of E8 attaches to the exterior side of E6. L3, a target of TRIM5α-mediated restriction 11 , binds as a hexamer of dimers to the interior side. Furthermore, the viral helicase D5, which is required for genome release from cores 12 , associates with cytoplasmic cores during infection by docking onto the exterior E8 rim of the portal complex. We propose that the portal complex represents an attractive target for the development of anti-poxvirus therapeutics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Poxviruses, including human pathogens such as variola and monkeypox, remain a public-health concern, and recent mpox outbreaks highlight gaps in understanding poxvirus biology that could inform therapeutic development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used cryo-electron tomography with subtomogram averaging and structure prediction to determine the structure and composition of the portal complex in vaccinia virus, a prototypical poxvirus.
analysis.methods: Cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging and structure prediction were used to resolve the portal complex, and its protein composition was identified through structural and interaction analyses.
analysis.main_results: The portal complex is a hexameric structure composed of E8, E6 and L3 proteins, with E6 forming the central chamber and interacting with the core wall, E8 attaching externally, and L3 binding internally as hexameric dimers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors propose that the portal complex, essential for mRNA release and virus assembly, represents a potential target for anti-poxvirus therapeutics, highlighting its structural conservation and functional roles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting the portal complex could inform the development of antiviral strategies against poxviruses, including mpox, by disrupting essential assembly and infection processes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to vaccinia virus, a related poxvirus, and the evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on structural inference and the absence of direct functional validation in mpox virus.

analysis.summary_en: This study resolves the in situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex in vaccinia virus using cryo-electron tomography and subtomogram averaging, identifying a hexameric assembly of E8, E6 and L3 proteins. E6 forms the central chamber interacting with the core wall, E8 attaches externally, and L3 binds internally as hexameric dimers. The portal complex is essential for mRNA release during infection and virus assembly, and the viral helicase D5 associates with cytoplasmic cores by docking onto the E8 rim. The authors propose the portal complex as a potential target for anti-poxvirus therapeutics, emphasizing its structural conservation and functional roles across poxviruses.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 痘病毒是一个大型、复杂的双链 DNA 病毒家族,其中包括人类病原体,例如天花(天花的病因)和猴痘。最近的 猴痘 的 暴发 强调需要更好地了解痘病毒生物学 1,2。痘病毒组装是一个保守的过程,涉及在成熟病毒的膜内形成双凹核心 3,4。在这里,我们使用冷冻电子断层扫描结合亚断层平均和结构预测来确定痘苗病毒(典型的痘病毒)中门静脉复合体(跨越核心壁的孔)的结构和组成。六聚体复合物由 E8、E6 和 L3 蛋白组成,这些蛋白在痘病毒中是保守的,并且对于感染建立过程中 mRNA 的释放至关重要 5-7。E6 也是病毒组装 8-10 所必需的,它形成门户的中央室并与周围的核心壁相互作用。E8 的六聚体附着在 E6 的外侧。L3 是 TRIM5α 介导的限制性靶标 11,以二聚体的六聚体形式与内侧结合。此外,基因组从核心12释放所需的病毒解旋酶D5在感染期间通过对接至门复合体的外部E8边缘与细胞质核心相关联。我们认为门静脉复合物代表了抗痘病毒疗法开发的一个有吸引力的靶点。

analysis_zh.methods: 冷冻电子断层扫描结合亚断层平均和结构预测用于解析门静脉复合物,并通过结构和相互作用分析鉴定其蛋白质组成。
analysis_zh.main_results: 门静脉复合体是由E8、E6和L3蛋白组成的六聚体结构,其中E6形成中央室并与核心壁相互作用,E8附着在外部,L3作为六聚体二聚体在内部结合。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者提出,对于 mRNA 释放和病毒组装至关重要的门户复合体代表了抗痘病毒治疗的潜在靶点,强调了其结构保守和功能作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对门户复合体可以通过破坏基本的组装和感染过程来为针对痘病毒(包括 猴痘)的 抗病毒药物 策略的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于牛痘病毒(一种相关的痘病毒),由于依赖结构推论且缺乏 猴痘病毒 中的直接功能验证,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Mpox virus can suppress virus sensing and antiviral Responses in testicular cells: potential role of Sirtuins 2310247
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction The global outbreak of Mpox virus (MPXV) clade IIb, comprising ∼106,000 cases predominantly in men, has raised serious concerns regarding sexual transmission. Pox viruses evade immune detection by blocking pathogen sensing and inhibiting antiviral responses. We here characterized MPXV infection in human testicular cells to gain insights into the landscape of cell-type-specific testicular response to infection. Methods Human primary Sertoli (SC) and Leydig (LC) cells were infected with MPXV clade IIb (MOI 0.005). Infection was confirmed by quantitative PCR and plaque assays. RNA-seq analysis was conducted using RNA samples from infected SC and LC at days 1, 3, and 5 post-infection (dpi). Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified based on strict cutoffs (log2 fold-change >|1.5|; adj. p-value < 0.05) and analyzed for enrichment in virus-response and steroidogenesis pathways using Ingenuity Pathway Analysis. Results Productive infection was confirmed in both SC and LC with peak virus titers at 5 dpi without significant cell death. Although viral replication was evident by 1 dpi, the number of DEGs remained low (86 in LC and 51 in SC), while they were above 3000 at 5 dpi in both cell types. Notably, canonical viral sensing, cell death, and inflammatory pathways showed no significant activation in either cell type at any time point. Sirtuin family genes (SIRTs) were upregulated at 3 and 5 dpi, correlating with downregulation of antiviral response genes, including DNA virus-sensing gene IFI16. Conclusion This is the first evidence that MPXV can infect key human testicular types and suppress key antiviral pathways similar to vaccinia virus. In addition to functioning as post-virus sensing immune brakes, SIRTs are also crucial for spermatogenesis. Our data suggest that SIRT upregulation favors viral replication by promoting cell survival via autophagy and apoptosis inhibition, while simultaneously dampening innate immunity through suppression of NF-κB and interferon signaling. Funding Source R03AI188484 Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) clade IIb 的全球 暴发 包括约 106,000 例病例,主要发生在男性中,引起了对性 传播 的严重关注。痘病毒通过阻断病原体感应和抑制 抗病毒药物 反应来逃避免疫检测。

papers.title_zh: 猴痘病毒 可以抑制睾丸细胞中的病毒感应和 抗病毒药物 反应:Sirtuins 的潜在作用 2310247
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction The global outbreak of Mpox virus (MPXV) clade IIb, comprising ∼106,000 cases predominantly in men, has raised serious concerns regarding sexual transmission. Pox viruses evade immune detection by blocking pathogen sensing and inhibiting antiviral responses. We here characterized MPXV infection in human testicular cells to gain insights into the landscape of cell-type-specific testicular response to infection. Methods Human primary Sertoli (SC) and Leydig (LC) cells were infected with MPXV clade IIb (MOI 0.005). Infection was confirmed by quantitative PCR and plaque assays. RNA-seq analysis was conducted using RNA samples from infected SC and LC at days 1, 3, and 5 post-infection (dpi). Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified based on strict cutoffs (log2 fold-change >|1.5|; adj. p-value < 0.05) and analyzed for enrichment in virus-response and steroidogenesis pathways using Ingenuity Pathway Analysis. Results Productive infection was confirmed in both SC and LC with peak virus titers at 5 dpi without significant cell death. Although viral replication was evident by 1 dpi, the number of DEGs remained low (86 in LC and 51 in SC), while they were above 3000 at 5 dpi in both cell types. Notably, canonical viral sensing, cell death, and inflammatory pathways showed no significant activation in either cell type at any time point. Sirtuin family genes (SIRTs) were upregulated at 3 and 5 dpi, correlating with downregulation of antiviral response genes, including DNA virus-sensing gene IFI16. Conclusion This is the first evidence that MPXV can infect key human testicular types and suppress key antiviral pathways similar to vaccinia virus. In addition to functioning as post-virus sensing immune brakes, SIRTs are also crucial for spermatogenesis. Our data suggest that SIRT upregulation favors viral replication by promoting cell survival via autophagy and apoptosis inhibition, while simultaneously dampening innate immunity through suppression of NF-κB and interferon signaling. papers.title: Mpox research coordination to effectively support response efforts in Africa: Lessons learned, challenges, and way forward
papers.abstract: Mpox, caused by the mpox virus, has evolved from isolated cases in endemic regions to widespread outbreaks affecting multiple countries in Africa. The Research and Innovation pillar of the Continental Incident Management Support Team (IMST) was established to generate evidence that supports response efforts, including analysing the efficiency and effectiveness of clinical trials and health research on mpox across Africa. This article describes the achievements, challenges faced and lessons learned from mpox research efforts. The contributions of research to the mpox response by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) are crucial to managing infectious disease outbreaks across the continent. Multiple research initiatives were coordinated across Member States, including socio-behavioural, epidemiological, diagnostic, vaccine and therapeutic studies. Key achievements included the establishment of a coordinated continental research platform, initiation of multi-country studies and mapping of ongoing mpox research activities across Africa. Challenges included bureaucratic procedures, delays in funding disbursement, ethical approval bottlenecks, coordination complexities and surveillance gaps that affected timely research implementation. Addressing these gaps has the potential to enhance evidence-based decision-making and provide valuable lessons for improving future epidemic preparedness and response in Africa. Contribution: The mpox research demonstrated the vitality of collaborative research efforts, the need for continuous, systematic monitoring of its progress and the need for real-time dissemination of research findings to inform practices that ensure an effective response to mpox. Real-time dissemination of research findings, starting with early community engagement, is critical to ensure that research findings are translated into action.

papers.title: Dual-mode recombinase polymerase amplification platform for simultaneous detection and clade differentiation of monkeypox virus via fluorescence and biosensing
papers.abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) continues to present a significant global public health challenge, highlighting the critical necessity for rapid molecular diagnostics capable of simultaneously identifying viral infection and discriminating between circulating clades. In this study, we developed a fluorescent and lateral flow biosensor (LFB)-based duplex recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) platform for the concurrent detection of clade I and clade II MPXV. By integrating the RPA technique with either fluorescence-based real-time monitoring or LFB-based visual readout, the dual-target amplification process is translated into flexible and informative detection outputs. Under single-target conditions, the assays consistently detected clade I and clade II MPXV at concentrations as low as 6.8 × 10 −1 and 7.7 × 10 −1 copies/μL, respectively. Although sensitivity decreased under duplex conditions, both targets remained reliably detectable within a single reaction. The assays further demonstrated high analytical specificity, exhibiting no detectable cross-reactivity with non-MPXV pathogens. The platform demonstrated consistent qualitative performance in simulated clinical samples, including serum, skin swabs, and nasopharyngeal swabs, while indicating potential matrix effects on detection sensitivity. The entire detection workflow, spanning from amplification to result interpretation, can be completed within 25 min. The provision of two selectable readout formats facilitates adaptation to both centralized laboratory analyses and decentralized or point-of-care testing scenarios. Overall, this duplex RPA platform provides a rapid, sensitive, and versatile diagnostic strategy for MPXV surveillance and differential diagnosis.

In this study, we developed a fluorescent and lateral flow biosensor (LFB)-based duplex recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) platform for the concurrent detection of clade I and clade II MPXV. By integrating the RPA technique with either fluorescence-based real-time monitoring or LFB-based visual readout, the dual-target amplification process is translated into flexible and informative detection outputs. Under single-target conditions, the assays consistently detected clade I and clade II MPXV at concentrations as low as 6.8 × 10 −1 and 7.7 × 10 −1 copies/μL, respectively. Although sensitivity decreased under duplex conditions, both targets remained reliably detectable within a single reaction. The assays further demonstrated high analytical specificity, exhibiting no detectable cross-reactivity with non-MPXV pathogens. The platform demonstrated consistent qualitative performance in simulated clinical samples, including serum, skin swabs, and nasopharyngeal swabs, while indicating potential matrix effects on detection sensitivity. The entire detection workflow, spanning from amplification to result interpretation, can be completed within 25 min. The provision of two selectable readout formats facilitates adaptation to both centralized laboratory analyses and decentralized or point-of-care testing scenarios. Overall, this duplex RPA platform provides a rapid, sensitive, and versatile diagnostic strategy for MPXV surveillance and differential diagnosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)继续对全球公共卫生构成重大挑战,凸显了快速分子诊断的迫切必要性,该诊断能够同时识别病毒感染并区分流行的进化枝。在本研究中,我们开发了一种基于荧光和侧流生物传感器 (LFB) 的双链重组酶聚合酶扩增 (RPA) 平台,用于同时检测进化枝 I 和进化枝 II MPXV。通过将 RPA 技术与基于荧光的实时监测或基于 LFB 的视觉读数相结合,双目标放大过程可转化为灵活且信息丰富的检测输出。在单靶标条件下,检测结果一致地检测到分支 I 和分支 II MPXV,浓度分别低至 6.8 × 10 -1 和 7.7 × 10 -1 拷贝/μL。尽管在双工条件下灵敏度下降,但两个目标在单个反应中仍然可以可靠地检测到。该测定进一步证明了高分析特异性,与非 MPXV 病原体未表现出可检测到的交叉反应性。该平台在模拟临床样本(包括血清、皮肤拭子和鼻咽拭子)中表现出一致的定性性能,同时表明基质对检测灵敏度的潜在影响。从扩增到结果解释的整个检测工作流程可以在 25 分钟内完成。提供两种可选的读数格式有助于适应集中实验室分析和分散或即时检测场景。总体而言,该双工 RPA 平台为 MPXV 监测 和差分 诊断 提供快速、灵敏且多功能的诊断策略。

papers.title: Assessment of knowledge, perceptions, and preventive practices regarding Mpox among the Congolese population living in Brazzaville
papers.abstract: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) has re-emerged as a global health threat. However, little is known about public awareness and responses in urban African populations. The Republic of Congo has experienced sporadic Mpox outbreaks over several decades, with Brazzaville, the capital, identified as the epicenter of the 2025 outbreak. Despite this, no study has assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of the population regarding Mpox. This study aimed to evaluate the KAP of Congolese residents toward Mpox. A cross-sectional, community-based survey was conducted in March 2025 in Brazzaville, targeting health districts with confirmed Mpox cases. A three-stage cluster sampling method was used to select individuals aged 15 and older from diverse social backgrounds. Data were collected through a standardized KAP questionnaire and analyzed using multivariable logistic regression to identify factors associated with knowledge, perceptions, and practices. A total of 567 participants were enrolled (46% male, 54% female). Overall, 89.6% (95% CI 86.8–91.8) demonstrated poor knowledge of Mpox, while 10.4% (95% CI 8.2–13.2) achieved a good knowledge score. Only 7.4% (95% CI 5.5–9.9) correctly identified a virus as the cause, and 38.0% (95% CI 34.1–42.0) had previously heard of the disease. Moderate to low-risk perception was observed in 61.0% (95% CI 57.1–65.1), and 67.0% (95% CI 63.0–70.8) of participants exhibited poor preventive practices. Better knowledge was associated with secondary education (aOR = 2.48; 95% CI 1.38–4.45), middle income (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI 0.05–0.35), and female gender (aOR = 0.35; 95% CI 0.18–0.64). Government employees and residents of Djiri and Talangaï districts reported better practices. Only 28% expressed strong trust in a hypothetical Mpox vaccine, and 19% believed that most community members would accept vaccination. Despite the ongoing outbreak, knowledge, perception, and preventive behaviors related to Mpox remain alarmingly low in Brazzaville. There is an urgent need for expanded public awareness campaigns and enhanced communication strategies to build trust and strengthen outbreak preparedness and response in the Republic of Congo.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed knowledge, perceptions, and preventive practices regarding Mpox among the Congolese population in Brazzaville. It found that most participants had poor knowledge of Mpox, with only 10.4% achieving a good knowledge score. Risk perception was moderate to low, and preventive practices were poor in 67.0% of participants. Better knowledge was linked to secondary education, middle income, and female gender. Government employees and residents of specific districts showed better practices. Public trust in a hypothetical Mpox vaccine was low, with only 28% expressing strong trust. The study highlights the need for improved awareness and communication strategies to enhance outbreak preparedness and response in the Republic of Congo. The evidence is based on a cross-sectional survey conducted in March 2025, with no reported limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘(以前称为猴痘)重新成为全球健康威胁。然而,人们对非洲城市人口的公众意识和反应知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 3 月,布拉柴维尔针对出现 猴痘 确诊病例的卫生区开展了一项基于社区的横断面调查。共有 567 名参与者参加(46% 男性,54% 女性)。
elements_zh.methods: 通过标准化 KAP 问卷收集数据,并使用多变量逻辑回归进行分析,以确定与知识、看法和实践相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体而言,89.6% (95% CI 86.8–91.8) 的受访者对 猴痘 的了解较差,而 10.4% (95% CI 8.2–13.2) 的受访者获得了良好的知识得分。只有 7.4% (95% CI 5.5–9.9) 正确识别病毒为病因,38.0% (95% CI 34.1–42.0) 以前听说过这种疾病。61.0% (95% CI 57.1–65.1) 的参与者认为存在中度至低风险,67.0% (95% CI 63.0–70.8) 的参与者表现出不良的预防措施。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 更好的知识与中等教育(aOR = 2.48;95% CI 1.38–4.45)、中等收入(aOR = 0.13;95% CI 0.05–0.35)和女性(aOR = 0.35;95% CI 0.18–0.64)相关。吉里和塔兰盖地区的政府雇员和居民报告了更好的做法。

papers.title_zh: 对居住在布拉柴维尔的刚果居民有关 猴痘 的知识、看法和预防措施进行评估
papers.source_body_en: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) has re-emerged as a global health threat. However, little is known about public awareness and responses in urban African populations. The Republic of Congo has experienced sporadic Mpox outbreaks over several decades, with Brazzaville, the capital, identified as the epicenter of the 2025 outbreak. Despite this, no study has assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of the population regarding Mpox. This study aimed to evaluate the KAP of Congolese residents toward Mpox. A cross-sectional, community-based survey was conducted in March 2025 in Brazzaville, targeting health districts with confirmed Mpox cases. A three-stage cluster sampling method was used to select individuals aged 15 and older from diverse social backgrounds. Data were collected through a standardized KAP questionnaire and analyzed using multivariable logistic regression to identify factors associated with knowledge, perceptions, and practices. A total of 567 participants were enrolled (46% male, 54% female). Overall, 89.6% (95% CI 86.8–91.8) demonstrated poor knowledge of Mpox, while 10.4% (95% CI 8.2–13.2) achieved a good knowledge score. Only 7.4% (95% CI 5.5–9.9) correctly identified a virus as the cause, and 38.0% (95% CI 34.1–42.0) had previously heard of the disease. Moderate to low-risk perception was observed in 61.0% (95% CI 57.1–65.1), and 67.0% (95% CI 63.0–70.8) of participants exhibited poor preventive practices. Better knowledge was associated with secondary education (aOR = 2.48; 95% CI 1.38–4.45), middle income (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI 0.05–0.35), and female gender (aOR = 0.35; 95% CI 0.18–0.64). Government employees and residents of Djiri and Talangaï districts reported better practices. Only 28% expressed strong trust in a hypothetical Mpox vaccine, and 19% believed that most community members would accept vaccination. Despite the ongoing outbreak, knowledge, perception, and preventive behaviors related to Mpox remain alarmingly low in Brazzaville. There is an urgent need for expanded public awareness campaigns and enhanced communication strategies to build trust and strengthen outbreak preparedness and response in the Republic of Congo.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘(以前称为猴痘)重新成为全球健康威胁。然而,人们对非洲城市人口的公众意识和反应知之甚少。刚果共和国几十年来经历了零星的 猴痘 暴发,首都布拉柴维尔被确定为 2025 年 暴发 的震中。尽管如此,还没有研究评估人们对 猴痘 的知识、态度和实践 (KAP)。本研究旨在评估刚果居民对 猴痘 的 KAP 程度。2025 年 3 月,布拉柴维尔针对出现 猴痘 确诊病例的卫生区开展了一项基于社区的横断面调查。采用三阶段整群抽样方法从不同社会背景中选择 15 岁及以上的个体。通过标准化 KAP 问卷收集数据,并使用多变量逻辑回归进行分析,以确定与知识、看法和实践相关的因素。共有 567 名参与者参加(46% 男性,54% 女性)。总体而言,89.6% (95% CI 86.8–91.8) 的受访者对 猴痘 的了解较差,而 10.4% (95% CI 8.2–13.2) 的受访者获得了良好的知识得分。只有 7.4% (95% CI 5.5–9.9) 正确识别病毒为病因,38.0% (95% CI 34.1–42.0) 以前听说过这种疾病。61.0% (95% CI 57.1–65.1) 的参与者认为存在中度至低风险,67.0% (95% CI 63.0–70.8) 的参与者表现出不良的预防措施。更好的知识与中等教育(aOR = 2.48;95% CI 1.38–4.45)、中等收入(aOR = 0.13;95% CI 0.05–0.35)和女性(aOR = 0.35;95% CI 0.18–0.64)相关。吉里和塔兰盖地区的政府雇员和居民报告了更好的做法。只有 28% 的人对假设的 猴痘 疫苗 表示强烈信任,19% 的人认为大多数社区成员会接受 疫苗接种。尽管 暴发 正在进行,但布拉柴维尔与 猴痘 相关的知识、认知和预防行为仍然低得惊人。迫切需要扩大公众意识活动并加强沟通战略,以建立信任并加强刚果共和国的 暴发 准备和响应。

papers.title: Treatment of mpox with tecovirimat under expanded access use in the Central African Republic.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This programme primarily aimed to provide access to tecovirimat for patients with suspected mpox. Secondary objectives were to describe the clinical and virological features of Clade Ia mpox and assess the safety of tecovirimat. The programme also supported research capacity strengthening, improved case detection through surveillance engagement, and standardised case management. METHODS: An expanded access programme was implemented at Mbaiki District Hospital and Bangui General Hospital. Consenting patients with suspected mpox received oral tecovirimat for 14 days under a standardised protocol. Follow-up visits occurred at day 21 (if PCR-positive at day 14) and day 28 or later. Blood and lesion samples were collected at each visit. RESULTS: Thirty-one patients were enrolled; 26 (84%) were PCR-positive and 24 (77%) had Clade Ia mpox. Symptoms were heterogeneous, most commonly lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, and active lesions. Most symptoms improved by day 14 and the final visit, though lymphadenopathy often persisted. PCR positivity declined over time but remained detectable in some cases. Six serious adverse events occurred in five patients. CONCLUSIONS: While no clear treatment benefit was demonstrated, the programme improved understanding of disease and strengthened clinical and research capacity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在为疑似 特考韦瑞 的患者提供 特考韦瑞 的使用机会,并描述 Clade Ia 猴痘 的临床和病毒学特征,同时评估 特考韦瑞 的安全性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 姆拜基区医院和班吉综合医院实施了扩大准入计划,招募了同意的疑似 猴痘 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 患者按照标准化方案接受口服 特考韦瑞 14 天,并在第 21 天(如果第 14 天 PCR 呈阳性)和第 28 天或之后进行随访,在此期间收集血液和病变样本。
elements_zh.main_results: 共有 31 名患者入组;26 例 (84%) 为 PCR 阳性,24 例 (77%) 为 Ia 型 猴痘。症状多种多样,最常见的是淋巴结肿大、头痛、肌痛和活动性病变,大多数在第 14 天和最后一次就诊时有所改善,但淋巴结肿大常常持续存在。五名患者发生六次严重不良事件。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虽然没有证明 治疗 具有明显的益处,但该计划提高了对疾病的了解并增强了临床和研究能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该计划支持加强研究能力,通过 监测 参与改进病例检测,并标准化 猴痘 的病例管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管该研究提供了有关 特考韦瑞 在资源有限的环境中使用的有价值的真实数据,但由于样本量较小且缺乏对照组,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Automated Multilabel Mpox Research Classification with Explainable Transformer Models
papers.abstract: The Mpox outbreak remains a serious public health issue, with the WHO (World Health Organization) reporting increasing cases in some regions. Research on Mpox is vital for several reasons, including vaccine development, diagnostic improvement, viral evolution studies, and preventing future outbreaks. However, the large amount of research being published makes it difficult to organize and analyze information efficiently. This study focuses on using multilabel classification to categorize 14590 Mpox research articles into key topics such as outbreaks, vaccination, and epidemiology. Among the different AI models tested, BERT performed the best, achieving 97.05% accuracy, 97.67% micro F1 score, and 96.46% macro F1 score. To better understand how the model makes decisions, SHAP was used to analyze significant word features and patterns. The results show that BERT can help automate the classification of Mpox research, making it easier for researchers, policymakers, and healthcare workers to quickly find relevant information, saving time and improving public health efforts.

papers.title: A Successful Cross-Agency Model for Collaborative Response to Imported Infectious Disease: Investigation and Management of the First Confirmed Clade Ia Mpox Case in Shanghai, China
papers.abstract: Introduction: Historically, human infections with clade Ia monkeypox virus (MPXV) primarily occurred through zoonotic transmission with limited secondary human-to-human transmission. Recent studies suggest increasing evidence of human-to-human transmission of some clade Ia lineages. This report documents the first imported clade Ia mpox case in Shanghai, representing the second documented case in China. Methods: Patient demographics, clinical profiles, epidemiological history, and close contacts were obtained through interviews with the patient and attending physicians. Clinical specimens were collected for real-time fluorescent quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) and whole-genome sequencing. Contact tracing was implemented, involving a 21-day health monitoring of close contacts. Results: The patient presented with moderate symptoms, including fever, rash, and respiratory manifestations. Genome sequencing identified the virus as clade Ia, showing 99.96% nucleotide identity to a strain from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Eight close contacts were identified with no secondary infection reported. Conclusions: This case was confirmed as an imported clade Ia mpox case originating in the DRC. The “four JOINTs” cross-agency collaborative mechanism between the CDC and customs played a significant role in effectively stopping local transmission. Challenges in remote investigation highlight the need for stronger international collaboration. Establishing an integrated “early warning-control-tracking” system, coupled with public health intervention, is crucial for reducing importation risks and safeguarding national health security.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:从历史上看,人类感染 Ia 分支猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 主要通过人畜共患 传播 发生,并有有限的继发性人传人 传播。最近的研究表明,越来越多的证据表明某些 Ia 分支谱系存在人传人 传播 的情况。本报告记录了上海首例输入型 Ia 猴痘 病例,也是中国记录的第二例病例。方法:通过对患者和主治医生进行访谈,获得患者人口统计资料、临床概况、流行病学史和密切接触者。收集临床标本进行实时荧光定量聚合酶链反应(qPCR)和全 基因组 测序。实施接触者追踪,对密切接触者进行21天的健康监测。结果:患者出现中度症状,包括发烧、皮疹和呼吸道症状。基因组 测序鉴定该病毒为进化枝 Ia,与来自刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的病毒株显示出 99.96% 的核苷酸同一性。确定了 8 名密切接触者,没有报告继发感染。结论:该病例被确认为源自刚果民主共和国的输入性分支Ia 猴痘病例。疾控中心与海关“四联”跨部门协作机制,为有效遏制当地传播发挥了重要作用。远程调查的挑战凸显了加强国际合作的必要性。建立“预警-控制-追踪”一体化体系,配合公共卫生干预,对于降低输入风险、维护国家卫生安全至关重要。
